title: Special cocontinuous restriction preserves sheaves
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ a special cocontinuous functor, meaning that it is cocontinuous, continuous, locally faithful, locally full, and cover-dense with precisely the covering conditions of [def-weil-pbc-special-cocontinuous-functor]. Then the associated morphism of topoi $g:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ is an equivalence. Its inverse-image functor is precomposition with $u$, so precomposition is an equivalence between the categories of sheaves of sets on $\mathcal D$ and $\mathcal C$.
